name: Anara for Desktop
desc: Mac app for the Anara research workspace, outside the browser.
desc_zh: Anara 研究工作区的 Mac 客户端，不用打开浏览器
solves: Research dies in a graveyard of browser tabs. The desktop app sits in the Dock and keeps your library one click from the paper you are writing.
solves_zh: 研究工作容易被埋在一堆浏览器标签页里。桌面应用就在程序坞里，写论文时点一下就能回到自己的文献库。
best_for: You are deep in a draft and keep losing the tab that holds your library and citations.
best_for_zh: 你正在专心写稿，却总是找不到放着文献库和引文的那一个标签页。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://anara.com/updates and https://anara.com/blog , then the Anara produc）。 Released 2026-07-30 as a Mac app, in the discovery window, and missing from the ledger which holds only the web Anara (2025-03-23). The same update shipped Views. Anara's remote MCP server is documented at https://support.anara.com/en/articles/15334434-connect-ai-tools-to-anara-with-mcp but that article carries only an 'Updated' date of October 1, 2026, so its first public day is unconfirmed. Anara was formerly Unriddle. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://anara.com/updates/new-look
